broker.name: CMC Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 1989. Its site names FCA and BMA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:200.
broker.about: CMC Markets says it has operated since 1989. An address it publishes is 133 Houndsditch, London, United Kingdom, EC3A 7BX. Account names on its site include Standard CFD, FX Active, Equities, and Spread betting. Platforms named there include CMC web platform, CMC mobile app, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and TradingView. The site names these regulators: FCA and BMA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:200. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FCA: CMC Markets UK plc, 173730. BMA.

plans.name: Standard CFD
plans.billing_note: Global homepage FAQ describes a standard CFD account. UK comparison: retail leverage up to 30:1, minimum spread 0.2 points, commission on shares and ETFs only. No commission on UK and European share and ETF CFDs. US share and ETF CFDs from 10 USD.

plans.name: FX Active
plans.billing_note: Spreads from 0.0 pips on six major FX pairs and a 0.0025% commission per transaction. Homepage footnote also states 2.50 USD per 100,000 notional. UK retail maximum leverage 30:1.

plans.name: Equities
plans.billing_note: UK page: 16,000+ stocks and ETFs, 0% commission and no platform fees. A 0.7% FX fee may apply.

plans.name: Spread betting
plans.billing_note: UK page: 21,000+ instruments, retail leverage up to 30:1, minimum spread 0.2 points, no commission.

leverage.market: Retail, global homepage and international about page
leverage.note: Both pages label this maximum retail leverage. Homepage FAQ says 200:1, or 0.5% margin, on CFD and FX Active accounts.

leverage.market: UK retail spread betting, CFD and FX Active
leverage.note: UK account comparison. This is lower than the 1:200 figure on the global homepage.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Global homepage FAQ: there is no minimum deposit required to open an account. A trade still needs enough funds to cover the position.

other_fees.note: Homepage footnote: 2.50 USD per 100,000 notional on the FX Active account, spreads from 0.0 pips on six majors.

other_fees.label: UK dormancy fee
other_fees.note: Spread betting, CFD and FX Active, if no trading activity for one year. No fee on accounts with zero funds.

other_fees.label: UK equities FX fee
other_fees.note: Equities page says 0% commission and no platform fees.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. Group about page says the business was started in 1989. The London address is the registered address of CMC Markets UK plc. The global homepage FAQ refers to protection under the BMA rules, but it does not name the licensed entity or a BMA licence number. A separate about page says CMC Markets UK plc acts as a paying agent for CMC Markets Bermuda Limited. Those two facts are not combined into one licence. UK and global retail leverage figures differ, so both are kept. UK regulations page: FSCS up to 85,000 GBP for eligible clients. UK retail CFD and spread bet loss rate on that page: 69%. The global homepage risk extract said 50%.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: CMC Markets UK plc, registered in the United Kingdom, company number 02448409. Registered address 133 Houndsditch, London, EC3A 7BX. The international about page says this company acts as a paying agent for CMC Markets Bermuda Limited. FCA reference on the UK regulations page is 173730, which is not the company number.
